drafted_from: tool:check-the-model-server-and-restart-it-if-stuck's own row and test/check-the-model-server.test.mjs (a stand-in server that answers, one that hangs then recovers after the declared restart, and report-only), run here Nov 22 2026
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that my model server still loads models", with {"restart": false} to only look. It runs tool:check-the-model-server-and-restart-it-if-stuck and answers {"healthy": true, "probe": {"model": "gemma3:4b", "loads": true, "ms": 16697}} when a small model loads in time, or what it saw before and after the server's declared restart when it did not.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it checks the server, may restart it, and answers; the workflow that runs it keeps the finding row.
instructions: 1. Put the server's health settings in read-data/models-on-this-computer.json server.health: the probe model (a small one no job keeps loaded), the limit a load may take, and restart.argv, the declared restart of your model server.

2. Say "Check that my model server still loads models"; the AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run and tool tool:check-the-model-server-and-restart-it-if-stuck. Give {"restart": false} to only look, or {"limit_seconds": 1} to prove the restart path.

3. Read the answer: healthy with the probe's time, or the probe's failure, the models loaded before, the restart's exit and time, how long the server took to answer again and the probe after it. workflow:keep-the-model-server-loading-models runs it every 15 minutes and keeps a finding row when it restarted.

worked_examples.title: A server that stops loading models is restarted with its declared argv
worked_examples.ask: Check that my model server still loads models.
worked_examples.given: From test/check-the-model-server.test.mjs, which I ran: a stand-in server that never answers a chat, whose declared restart argv is ['/usr/bin/true', '{uid}'] and which answers again half a second later; the request lowers the probe limit to 1 s.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"healthy": false, "probe": {"loads": false, "why": "no answer in 1 s"}, "before": {"loaded": ["held:latest"]}, "restart": {"argv": ["/usr/bin/true", "501"], "exit": 0}, "back_after_ms": 3, "after": {"probe": {"loads": true}}, "signature": "stalls after an eviction"}
